text.en:
The name of the Lawa-an Elementary School situated in Sitio Lawa-an, Municipality of
Pantukan, Province of Davao del Norte, is hereby changed to Doroteo de Castro Elementary School.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: March 16, 1982
